title.zh: EVE 学院：工业生产基础

blocks.en: Almost every item you interact with in EVE was built by players,
blocks.zh: 你在 EVE 中接触到的几乎每件物品都是玩家制造的，

blocks.en: from the ammo in your guns,
blocks.zh: 从炮里的弹药、

blocks.en: to the ships you fly,
blocks.zh: 到你驾驶的舰船，

blocks.en: to massive space stations.
blocks.zh: 再到巨大的空间站。

blocks.en: Shaping the universe of New Eden with the items you build
blocks.zh: 对于愿意投入精力的勤劳飞行员来说，

blocks.en: can be a deep and rewarding experience
blocks.zh: 用自己制造的物品塑造新伊甸的宇宙，

blocks.en: for those industrious pilots willing to do the work.
blocks.zh: 可以是一种深度而有成就感的体验。

blocks.en: Before you are able to get started,
blocks.zh: 在开始之前，

blocks.en: you first need to find a station to work from
blocks.zh: 你首先需要找到一个可以作为工作基地、

blocks.en: which has manufacturing facilities for you to use.
blocks.zh: 拥有制造设施的空间站。

blocks.en: You can find stations with production facilities
blocks.zh: 要找到有生产设施的空间站，

blocks.en: by opening the Industry window,
blocks.zh: 可以打开工业窗口，

blocks.en: going to the Facilities tab,
blocks.zh: 进入「设施（Facilities）」标签页，

blocks.en: and looking for stations with Manufacturing services installed.
blocks.zh: 寻找安装了制造服务的空间站。

blocks.en: Player-owned Upwell structures
blocks.zh: 玩家拥有的昇威建筑

blocks.en: can be set up for better manufacturing bonuses,
blocks.zh: 可以配置更好的制造加成，

blocks.en: and they're often the best locations to set up your production from.
blocks.zh: 通常是开展生产的最佳地点。

blocks.en: Look for Engineering complexes,
blocks.zh: 寻找工程复合体（Engineering Complex），

blocks.en: such as a Raitaru,
blocks.zh: 比如莱塔卢（Raitaru），

blocks.en: as they are bonused for manufacturing and research.
blocks.zh: 它们拥有制造和研究加成。

blocks.en: If you're interested in committing heavily to industry,
blocks.zh: 如果你有意深耕工业，

blocks.en: consider joining a player corporation,
blocks.zh: 可以考虑加入一个玩家军团，

blocks.en: which has these structures available for their members to use.
blocks.zh: 军团里会有这类建筑供成员使用。

blocks.en: Basic manufacturing in EVE involves using a blueprint
blocks.zh: EVE 中的基础制造，就是使用蓝图

blocks.en: to assemble various materials into goods.
blocks.zh: 把各种材料组装成产品。

blocks.en: If you want to make something,
blocks.zh: 如果你想制造某样东西，

blocks.en: you'll first want to acquire the blueprint for that item.
blocks.zh: 首先要获得该物品的蓝图。

blocks.en: Together with the base materials,
blocks.zh: 再加上基础材料，

blocks.en: you can build anything!
blocks.zh: 你就什么都能造！

blocks.en: Many tech 1 blueprint originals, or BPO's,
blocks.zh: 很多 T1 蓝图原件（BPO）

blocks.en: can be found on the markets of New Eden.
blocks.zh: 都能在新伊甸的市场上买到。

blocks.en: These are non-consumable
blocks.zh: 它们不会被消耗，

blocks.en: and can be used as long as you own the blueprint.
blocks.zh: 只要你拥有蓝图就能一直使用。

blocks.en: Tech 2 ships and module blueprints
blocks.zh: T2 舰船和装备的蓝图

blocks.en: are created through a process called Invention,
blocks.zh: 通过一种叫做「发明（Invention）」的流程制造，

blocks.en: which uses Blueprint Copies,
blocks.zh: 这需要用到蓝图拷贝，

blocks.en: and is covered in a separate video.
blocks.zh: 我们会在另一个视频中介绍。

blocks.en: For now,
blocks.zh: 现在，

blocks.en: simply open the market browser and find what you want!
blocks.zh: 只需打开市场浏览器，找到你想要的东西！

blocks.en: Once you've got your blueprint,
blocks.zh: 拿到蓝图后，

blocks.en: click on the Industry button in the station services,
blocks.zh: 点击空间站服务中的「工业」按钮，

blocks.en: or use your Neocom to open up the Industry window.
blocks.zh: 或通过 Neocom 打开工业窗口。

blocks.en: The Industry window will show any blueprints you own,
blocks.zh: 工业窗口会显示你拥有的所有蓝图，

blocks.en: and you can filter them by type and location.
blocks.zh: 你可以按类型和位置筛选。

blocks.en: Drag a blueprint into the center of the window
blocks.zh: 把蓝图拖到窗口中央，

blocks.en: to install it and preview your job.
blocks.zh: 即可安装蓝图并预览你的工作。

blocks.en: For production, make sure you select the yellow "Manufacturing" button.
blocks.zh: 生产时，务必选择黄色的「制造（Manufacturing）」按钮。

blocks.en: The Industry window has three main components.
blocks.zh: 工业窗口有三个主要部分。

blocks.en: On the left are your input materials.
blocks.zh: 左边是你的投入材料。

blocks.en: For most Tech 1 blueprints
blocks.zh: 大多数 T1 蓝图

blocks.en: you will only need minerals created by reprocessing ore.
blocks.zh: 只需要提炼矿石得到的矿物。

blocks.en: In the middle is your currently installed blueprint.
blocks.zh: 中间是当前安装的蓝图。

blocks.en: Here you can also see the current number of runs,
blocks.zh: 这里还能看到当前的流程数，

blocks.en: and the research levels of the blueprint,
blocks.zh: 以及蓝图的研究等级，

blocks.en: which we'll discuss in more detail later in this video.
blocks.zh: 本视频稍后会详细讨论。

blocks.en: Finally, the right-hand side will show your output.
blocks.zh: 最后，右侧显示你的产出。

blocks.en: Here, you can select the input location for materials,
blocks.zh: 在这里，你可以选择材料的投入位置、

blocks.en: output location for your produce,
blocks.zh: 产品的产出位置，

blocks.en: and view both the job cost, and time to complete.
blocks.zh: 并查看工作费用和完成所需时间。

blocks.en: Note how many manufacturing jobs you have available
blocks.zh: 留意你还有多少个可用的制造工作槽，

blocks.en: as you can run multiple jobs at once.
blocks.zh: 因为你可以同时运行多项工作。

blocks.en: If you're looking to make multiple of an item,
blocks.zh: 如果你想制造多个同一物品，

blocks.en: you can set the job to run multiple times,
blocks.zh: 可以把工作设置为运行多个流程，

blocks.en: for example, 5 times to make 5 drones.
blocks.zh: 例如运行 5 次来制造 5 架无人机。

blocks.en: This will alter the time and material cost accordingly
blocks.zh: 时间和材料消耗会相应变化，

blocks.en: and will only take up one manufacturing job slot.
blocks.zh: 而且只占用一个制造工作槽。

blocks.en: When you're ready, start the job!
blocks.zh: 准备好后，就开始工作吧！

blocks.en: Once your manufacturing job is running,
blocks.zh: 制造工作开始运行后，

blocks.en: you can head to the Jobs tab to see the production time remaining.
blocks.zh: 可以前往「工作（Jobs）」标签页查看剩余生产时间。

blocks.en: Once it finishes,
blocks.zh: 完成后，

blocks.en: click "Deliver" to receive your goods and get your blueprint back.
blocks.zh: 点击「交付（Deliver）」领取产品并取回蓝图。

blocks.en: A blueprint purchased off the market can be improved by researching it.
blocks.zh: 从市场上买来的蓝图可以通过研究来改进。

blocks.en: Researching a blueprint for Material Efficiency
blocks.zh: 研究蓝图的材料效率（ME）

blocks.en: reduces the amount of input materials required to run the blueprint,
blocks.zh: 可以减少使用蓝图所需的投入材料，

blocks.en: and research for Time Efficiency
blocks.zh: 研究时间效率（TE）

blocks.en: makes jobs using that blueprint complete faster.
blocks.zh: 则能让使用该蓝图的工作更快完成。

blocks.en: Improving these stats can be key
blocks.zh: 在竞争激烈的市场中，提升这些属性

blocks.en: to turning a profit in a competitive market.
blocks.zh: 可能是盈利的关键。

blocks.en: To research a blueprint,
blocks.zh: 要研究蓝图，

blocks.en: you will first want to find a structure with research facilities.
blocks.zh: 首先要找到一座拥有研究设施的建筑。

blocks.en: It is best to use player-owned engineering complexes
blocks.zh: 如果能找到可用的玩家工程复合体，

blocks.en: if you can find one to use.
blocks.zh: 最好就用它。

blocks.en: You may want to do research in one station
blocks.zh: 你也可以在一个空间站做研究，

blocks.en: and then bring copies of your blueprints to another for manufacturing.
blocks.zh: 然后把蓝图拷贝带到另一个空间站去制造。

blocks.en: Once you've researched your Blueprint Original,
blocks.zh: 研究完蓝图原件后，

blocks.en: you might want to make a copy of it.
blocks.zh: 你可能想复制它。

blocks.en: Blueprint copies, or BPCs,
blocks.zh: 蓝图拷贝（BPC）

blocks.en: are simply limited versions of the original blueprint,
blocks.zh: 其实就是蓝图原件的受限版本，

blocks.en: which will expire after a set number of uses.
blocks.zh: 使用一定次数后就会失效。

blocks.en: Fully researched BPCs are great to sell via contract to other players,
blocks.zh: 完全研究过的蓝图拷贝非常适合通过合同卖给其他玩家，

blocks.en: or for your own production!
blocks.zh: 或者留着自己生产！

blocks.en: You can feel a bit more secure moving blueprint copies
blocks.zh: 在危险的空间区域运送蓝图拷贝时，

blocks.en: through dangerous areas of space,
blocks.zh: 你可以更安心一些，

blocks.en: without risking losing the valuable original.
blocks.zh: 不必担心丢失珍贵的原件。

blocks.en: As with every aspect of EVE Online,
blocks.zh: 和 EVE Online 的方方面面一样，

blocks.en: industry can be better with friends.
blocks.zh: 工业也是和朋友一起玩更好。

blocks.en: Joining a corporation
blocks.zh: 加入军团

blocks.en: is a great way to open up new possibilities in your production chain,
blocks.zh: 是为你的生产链开辟新可能的好方法，

blocks.en: or gain new customers on the front lines of battle in New Eden.
blocks.zh: 也能在新伊甸的战斗前线找到新客户。
